requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL represent mission-to-track binding with a single `cdt:TrackLink` node on leaf mission Tasks, using compact candidate/bound state and deriving track/archive location from the real track id.

case.given: A mission TaskSpace includes a work item that may create or operate a track
case.when: The mission expresses the track relationship
case.then: The mission SHALL attach `cdt:TrackLink` to the leaf `Task`, not to a `TaskGroup`
case.and: `TaskGroup` and `Task` SHALL remain the source of mission execution status

case.given: A leaf Task has `cdt:TrackLink state="candidate" id="suggested-track-id"`
case.then: It SHALL update the same `cdt:TrackLink` to `state="bound"` with the real track id
case.and: It SHALL write a `reports/track-bind-XXX.md` report with candidate id, real id, task id, evidence, and timestamp

case.given: A `cdt:TrackLink` is bound to a real track id
case.when: The track moves from active tracks to archive
case.then: The mission SHALL NOT require a path or archive-path attribute update
case.and: Consumers SHALL derive active/archive location by resolving the id against `codument/tracks/` and `codument/archive/`

case.given: A mission has one or more `cdt:TrackLink state="bound"` nodes
case.then: It SHALL precheck whether each bound track id is archived, active, or missing
case.and: It SHALL NOT silently archive tracks in bulk
If bound tracks are active or missing, it SHALL report them and ask whether to run `codument-archive-track` for eligible active tracks or block
